title: 购物

explanations.1: Modifies the adjective 大 to mean 'very big'.
explanations.2: Used with 很 to indicate 'many things'.
explanations.3: Indicates the first action in a sequence.
explanations.4: Marks completion of the action 买.
explanations.5: Connects two nouns, apples and watermelon.
explanations.6: Indicates the next step in the sequence.
explanations.7: Verb meaning 'to ask', introducing a question.
explanations.8: Negates the verb 要 in a yes/no question.
explanations.9: Positive response to the question, meaning 'want'.
explanations.11: Numeral 'one' before the measure word 杯.
explanations.12: Measure word for cup of drink.
explanations.14: Conjunction showing contrast between tiredness and happiness.
explanations.15: Verb meaning 'to go back', part of phrase 回家.

translation: Today my mother and I went to the supermarket to buy things. The supermarket is very big, and there are many things. We first bought fruit. My mother bought apples and watermelon. I bought milk and bread. Then we went to buy meat. My mother asked me if I wanted chicken. I said yes. We bought half a kilogram of chicken. Finally we went to buy drinks. I chose a cup of cola. My mother bought tea. We were very tired, but very happy. We went home to cook dinner.
